subcategory_gloss: procurement, supplier terms, inventory and distribution operations
domain_rationale: Correctness is decided by a distributor's supplier-agreement settlement practice: when freight-shipped purchases count toward a quarter (receipt, not invoice), retroactive volume tiers on net purchases after returns, a growth bonus on the increase over the same quarter last year, handling charges on returns, price protection on stock on hand at a list-price drop, ship-and-debit chargebacks on contract sales below cost, and a minimum settlement carried forward. The deliverable is the quarterly supplier settlement statement of a distribution business, not software behaviour for its own sake. No task in workspace/tasks, dropped or revision settles supplier rebates (container-demurrage and 3PL billing bill customers for storage and handling; moving-average close is an accepted reference in inventory costing, a different ledger and rule set).
evidence: instruction.md: the schedule is 'the authority for these supplier settlements'; symptoms are settlement outcomes (freight at a quarter end, tiers, growth bonuses, return credits, settlements held back)

environment/app/docs/rebate-schedule.md: a numbered agreement schedule (carton shipment, price drop, contract sale, tier reached; purchases, returns, rebate, growth bonus, price protection, chargebacks, minimum settlement)
planned verifier: whole-statement comparison against expectations sealed from solution/model.py, derived from the schedule
